newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Overseas in JV talks with SHKP.
newsitem.headline: China Overseas in JV talks with SHKP.

text.p: China Overseas Land & Investment Ltd said on Wednesday it was in "very preliminary" talks with Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd about a joint venture to develop a residential project in China's Shenzhen.
"We are talking about a site, roughly about 600,000 square feet and the floor area of about 1.8 million square feet," a China Overseas official told Reuters.
"We have signed a preliminary agreement with local authorities to buy this site. We are only in early stages of discussions with Sun Hung Kai on cooperating on this site," he said.

The official said if China Overseas could not reach an agreement with Sun Hung Kai Properties, it would take on the project, in the Futian area, alone. Officials at Sun Hung Kai Properties were not immediately available for comment.
